title: Antiviral effects of Bovine antimicrobial peptide against TGEV in vivo and in vitro.
adjudication_summary: Source re-review repaired the paper-specific worker-2 activity rows and worker-4 DBAASP adjudication from local XML/PDF/figure/database evidence. APB-13 activity is now represented by supported CC50, safe-range, viral-inhibition, TCID50, replication-phase, and in vivo shedding records. Publication-grade acceptance is caution-bearing because the DBAASP IC50 REP duplicate rows are not primary-source reported and remain preserved as source_conflict.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML, extracted PDF text, OA package images/NXML/PDF, supplementary index/landing assets, and linked DBAASP rows were checked. No true supplementary data table exists for this DOI in local materials.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP linked assay/experiment rows were reconciled to source text. CC50 and four inhibition rows are source_verified; duplicate IC50 REP rows are retained as source_conflict because the paper does not report an IC50 endpoint.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 final activity now contains source-located APB-13 safe range, CC50, inhibition percentages, TCID50 reductions, replication-phase reduction, and in vivo viral-shedding qualitative effect. No database-only row is treated as primary activity evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 final mechanism is limited to direct time-of-addition/TCID50 and N mRNA/protein expression assays plus phenotype-level in vivo support; no untested host immune pathway is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: Local supplementary-index assets were checked and are article/publisher/reference landing pages; PMC/JATS metadata indicates no true supplement for this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Original rework ticket is closed because source-supported rows and conflict-preserving database adjudication now satisfy strict gates; acceptance remains caution-bearing.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Two linked DBAASP duplicate rows report IC50 REP at >62.5 µg/mL, but the primary source reports dose-specific inhibition percentages and TCID50 reductions, not an IC50 endpoint; preserved as source_conflict.
Figures were visually checked, but exact bar heights not stated in text were not promoted to exact numeric rows.
PMC/JATS metadata reports has-supplement=no; local supplementary landing assets are article/publisher/reference pages, not supplementary spreadsheets/tables for this DOI.

resolved_rework_targets.resolution: Source-supported activity rows added, DBAASP conflicts adjudicated, final review rewritten, and gates scheduled for rerun.

residual_source_limitations.impact: Exact bar heights in Figs. 1-5 beyond values stated in text were not promoted to numeric records; text-supported values and qualitative/significance claims were retained.
PMC/JATS metadata reports no supplement; local supplementary landing files are publisher/reference pages, not activity tables.
